headline: Eleven keeps the kettles busy.
body: The hour has a dry edge now; coats hang on the backs of chairs instead of over arms. Someone at the corner table turns a page and does not look up when the bell on the door gives its small, practised cough. Outside, the pavement has decided to be grey and stay that way.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: delivery van idling, hazard lights off
